create_classifier_free_guidance: create a ClassifierFreeGuidance instance with custom guidance_scale, guidance_rescale, and formulation options
run_classifier_free_guidance_forward: run the forward method of ClassifierFreeGuidance to combine conditional and unconditional predictions with guidance scaling
build_prepare_inputs: build prepared input batches from a data dictionary using ClassifierFreeGuidance.prepare_inputs
build_prepare_inputs_from_block_state: build prepared input batches from a BlockState object using ClassifierFreeGuidance.prepare_inputs_from_block_state
test_classifier_free_guidance_enabled: test whether ClassifierFreeGuidance is enabled based on guidance_scale, step range, and formulation settings
